description: Administrators only: what clients saw of their connection to us (PM-1573) — requests that got no answer (timed out or never connected), live streams that dropped or came back, a move to a company's fallback address, the tab hidden or shown, the network gone or back, the device asleep — as each device recorded it and sent it once anything answered. Filter by account (username or id), company (slug) and interval (from/to, or the last 'hours'). 'summary' is the interval in numbers: events by kind, stream drops per hour and by hour, the median and 95th percentile of how long a failed request waited, the share of requests and streams that went through a fallback ('viaEdgeShare') and of events that reached us through one ('arrivedViaEdgeShare'). Each event names its route as a template, never a key or a query, and 'lastRequestId' is the X-Request-Id of the last request that did answer — the line to read beside it in the server's log. Kept 30 days. This machine's rows only.

from.description: The interval's start, ISO 8601. Default: 'hours' before 'to'.

hours.description: The interval's length when 'from' is not given. Default 24, at most 744.

kind.description: Only events of this kind: request_failed, stream_drop, stream_up, route_changed, visibility, online, offline, sleep.

limit.description: How many events, newest first. Default 100, at most 500; 0 for the summary only.

slug.description: Only this company: its slug, 'acme' in acme.kaiku.tech.

to.description: The interval's end, ISO 8601. Default: now.

user.description: Only this account: its username or id.

name: admin_client_telemetry
